Chapter 642: Chapter 49 Xuanhuang Above (End of this volume, please subscribe)_2

Now, Lin Yuan’s “Xuanhuang Physique” has yet to be cultivated to a minor achievement.

Despite this, the strength of his physical body has directly doubled.

It is known… that Lin Yuan’s physical body, amplified by the Mysterious Gourd, is already nearly twenty times that of a normal power of the same rank.

On a twentyfold base, to then double again… Lin Yuan felt that with just the boundless power of his blood and qi, he might be able to penetrate numerous Spatial Layers and suppress the opening of tens of millions of Spatial Layers of a unique Ninth Rank.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path has always been adept at strengthening the body, and physically it tends to be more formidable than other Evolvers of the same rank, let alone with the boost from the Mysterious Gourd?

Besides.

...

The amplification of his body’s strength is only one aspect.

Upon cultivating the “Primordial Yellow Physique,” an aura known as ‘Protective Xuan Huang Light’ instinctively emanates from his body.

This aura may not be like the “Elemental Body,” which directly immunizes against ninety percent of attacks at the same rank.

But as long as the Protective Xuan Huang Light remains unbroken, Lin Yuan will not suffer any injury, whether it’s a physical attack, an attack by laws, or even other more mysterious assaults.

All will be blocked by the Protective Xuan Huang Light.

Protective Xuan Huang Light, Blood Rebirth, Elemental Body, Origin Clock.

These are currently Lin Yuan’s four main defensive measures.

Of course, the Origin Clock resides with his true self, but even relying on the first three, Lin Yuan’s defenses have nearly reached the pinnacle of the Ninth Rank.

It is estimation that even common Tenth Rank powerhouses would fail to break through Lin Yuan’s defenses.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan was chatting with his parents.

“By the way, Xiaoyuan, Yi Yi is planning to get married,” Lu Qiong immediately shared the joyful news with Lin Yuan.

“Lin Yi is planning to marry?” Lin Yuan was slightly startled, “So soon?”

He had indeed heard that his sister was dating someone, and that the two got along very well, but he hadn’t expected things to progress so quickly to the point of discussing marriage.

“What’s early?”

“She’s already in her nineties.”

“And you, Xiaoyuan, are already over a hundred years old.”

Lu Qiong rolled her eyes and brought up Lin Yuan’s age.

“Over a hundred years old…” Lin Yuan came back to his senses, momentarily lost in thought.

Evolvers have a prolonged lifespan. Even those of the First and Second Ranks, with the help of biotechnology, can easily live for several hundreds to thousands of years.

But his parents were ordinary people before and through the Human Civilization’s standard means, a typical citizen could generally live past two hundred years; so marrying in the nineties was considered late.

“Is Lin Yi’s boyfriend that lad from the Xia Family?” asked Lin Yuan.

“Yes, Xia Keren is honest, loyal, and dependable. Yi Yi will surely lead a good life with him,” Lu Qiong said gleefully.

“Honest?”

“Loyal and dependable?”

Lin Yuan remained silent.

The Xia Family was a great clan within Human Civilization, known as Human the Xia Family, with a history of producing citizens above the Eighth Layer. This generation even boasted an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse.

Being born in such a clan hardly associates with being honest or faithful.

Even the fact that he could marry Lin Yi might be a “political marriage,” aim being Lin Yi’s brother, Lin Yuan himself.

However, Lin Yuan was not concerned about these matters. At his level of prominence, attracting the attention of myriad powers, finding a simple relationship was simply unrealistic.

And since Human the Xia Family had a rather good reputation, marrying Lin Yi would mean that even if something unexpected happened to Lin Yuan, his parents would at least have a backing.

“Have Lin Yi’s boyfriend come to see me,” Lin Yuan said after some thought.

Generally, he would be reluctant to meet people from other powers, as it was overly trouble and complex.

But regarding his sister’s marriage, Lin Yuan still intended to take an interest.

Soon.

Less than ten minutes later.

A handsome young man appeared together with Lin Yi.

“Brother,” Lin Yi greeted with a radiant smile.

“Xia Keren, I have seen the Galaxy Master,” the handsome young man beside her said with a hint of nervous respect.

As a direct member of Human the Xia Family, Xia Keren would normally feel quite confident even facing Evolvers of the Seventh or Eighth Rank. But the Galaxy Master?

Before getting involved with Lin Yi, the ancient Eleventh Rank patriarch of the Xia Family had personally summoned Keren, repeatedly instructing him that if it was just for fun, he must not choose the sister of the Galaxy Master.

With so many women in Human Civilization, even many female members of Different Species, the Xia family, given its heritage, would not care.

However, when it came to the sister of the Galaxy Master, they absolutely could not cause any negative impact.

Otherwise, it could bring a catastrophic effect to the Xia Family.

The serious attitude of his ancient forebearer made Xia Keren truly understand the weight of the Galaxy Master.

“Xia Keren?” Lin Yuan smiled faintly, “Your Xia Family, has made significant contributions to Human Civilization.”

“Those are all matters of the past,” Xia Keren quickly replied, with no intention to boast at all.

Although from the Xia Family, Xia Keren had received a proper education from a young age and did not give off any sense of arrogance or conceit.

“Lin Yi is not like the scions of the great Evolutionary families. I hope that after you marry, she won’t have to suffer any grievances,” Lin Yuan said with a smile, looking at Xia Keren.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze, Xia Keren felt an invisible pressure. Despite the separation of the Virtual World, a shiver still ran through his heart.

“I will treat Yi Yi well,” Xia Keren immediately promised.

At the same time, he thought to himself, “The Galaxy Master gives me the same feeling as our ancient ancestor. No wonder he told me to be very careful with Yi Yi.”

His pursuit of Lin Yi was, indeed, influenced by the Galaxy Master, but more than that, Keren genuinely liked Lin Yi.

If it wasn’t for genuine affection, the ancient Eleventh Rank patriarch of the Xia Family would never have allowed Keren to continue the relationship with Lin Yi.
